item.title: Kongsberg Maritime Unveils Unified Digital Solutions Portfolio and Launches KM Performance
item.description: Kongsberg Maritime has marked a significant step forward in its digital transformation with the unveiling of a harmonized Digital Solutions portfolio and the launch of KM Performance, the first solution area out of the portfolio, which is designed to help customers in the marine transportation segment to strengthen operational efficiency, reduce emissions, and meet evolving regulatory demands.

item.title: Deep Sea, Deep Tech
item.description: Over the past decade, accelerating changes in the global climate have transformed how scientists and industry leaders observe and operate within some of the planet’s most extreme ocean environments. Nowhere is this shift more evident than in the Arctic, where there has been a surge in naval activity, undersea infrastructure development, and environmental monitoring efforts.

item.title: Electric Control in an Age of Deep-Sea Exploration
item.description: From underwater drones and remotely operated vehicles to manned submersibles and deep-sea research instruments, nearly every modern subsea system depends on electric motors, power electronics, and software. These technologies form the silent backbone of underwater operations, converting stored electrical energy into controlled mechanical action.

item.title: Transforming Marine Challenges into Opportunity
item.description: As of late, the marine industry has seen the formation of many consortia and groups that pool specialized expertise to offer—genuine—turnkey capabilities. Driven not only by need but also by the spirit of collaboration, groups like this can cross-pollinate across business lines to rapidly tackle complex briefs globally with an impressive range of technical applications.

item.title: Dissolved Oxygen Monitoring in Coastal & Aquaculture Operations
item.description: Dissolved oxygen is a critical indicator of water quality in coastal ecosystems and aquaculture operations. In natural coastal waters, oxygen levels influence habitat suitability, nutrient cycling, and ecosystem health. In aquaculture, dissolved oxygen directly affects the growth, feeding efficiency, and survival of fish and shellfish. Because oxygen conditions can change quickly, reliable measurements are essential for both environmental understanding and operational decision-making.

item.title: Jumbo Offshore Completes Mooring Line Installation Offshore Guyana
item.description: Jumbo Offshore has completed mooring pre-installation activities for the FPSO Errea Wittu for Exxon Mobil Guyana Ltd. at Uaru Field, Stabroek Block, Offshore Guyana, on behalf of Modec. The scope of work included the installation of suction anchors and the pre-lay of mooring lines in preparation for FPSO hook-up.
